text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Celebration! A total sweep of the Tiara Triple Crown GⅠ races...!
Truly a magnificent, historic feat! Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much,
Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I never imagined I'd be able to witness such a historic moment myself! I'm deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: For today, all I have is this bouquet, but I would love to properly host a celebration for you at a later date!

An unprecedented clean sweep of the entire Tiara route GⅠs!
With this historic feat,
Cesario instantly became the Umamusume of the hour.

That impact was especially prominent
within Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~! Cesario-saaan!
Please take this~!

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, my goal
is to win a GⅠ race on the Tiara route...!
Could you please say 'good luck' to me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...
Please calm down, everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...It brings me joy to know
that I could serve as a good guide for you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: However—I must show that I'm still on the same stage, that I am still her rival...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"When you occasionally forget,
it makes me feel just a little bit lonely."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, that's such a selfish worry to have, isn't it?
Even though I have Craft and the others."

When someone is deified like that while still active,
it takes the thrill out of competing... I can understand why it leaves a hollow feeling.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Though it's likely only temporary.
Shall we switch gears and get back to training?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: How would you feel about... a tandem run?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still-san!? S-Since when were you there!?
I'm sorry, I didn't notice you at all...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —And... did she say tandem training?

The one who suddenly appeared... was an Umamusume
cloaked in a mysterious aura—Still in Love.
She was the second Umamusume to achieve the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah... I'm so sorry...
I meant to hold it in, but I couldn't help it..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"No, if anything, we would be
more than happy to run alongside Still-san!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Oh my... is that true...?

"...With that, Still in Love cast an utterly
seductive glance toward Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Having watched the Twinkle Series... I've come to love your races...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So fierce it aches... Heheh,
as if laying everything bare—!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
I want to conquer you like that...!
On the burning turf... completely and utterly...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ha...... Ah... I'm so sorry... What came over me...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—No,
I'm honored you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I was beginning to feel a bit starved.
Allow me to enjoy our training run together.

And so, the two stood on the twilight turf.
With a crisp sound, the gates flew open—
and a fiercely contested race began.

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Still
text_block_list.text:
...!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!!
So fiercely did Still in Love snap at her heels—making one forget all about titles like a clean sweep of the Tiara GⅠs...

Dashing across the turf in the blink of an eye—
before long, they surged across the finish line
as if intertwining with one another.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
...Aah! I've still got a long way to go!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: This is why—this place really is so interesting...!

Even if one achieves an unprecedented title,
countless formidable rivals will still block the path ahead.
That is the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my.

Cesario's eyes sparkle with vitality.
This is still only halfway along the path. Yes—because the place she must reach lies in the distant future.
